meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Azure RBAC (use azure-rbac), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为AI代理配置Microsoft Entra身份与OAuth令牌交换
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Microsoft Entra中为AI代理管理身份和OAuth令牌交换。
copy.tagline_en: Provision Microsoft Entra identities and OAuth token exchange for AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage identities and OAuth token exchange for AI agents in Microsoft Entra.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 智能体创建和管理独立的 OAuth 2.0 身份，包括蓝图、主体和每个实例的身份，并配置令牌交换。
howto.when: 当你需要为 AI 智能体设置独立身份、配置 OAuth 令牌交换（如 fmi_path、OBO）或跨租户身份时触发。

say.text: 为我的新智能体创建一个身份蓝图。
为蓝图添加一个智能体实例身份。
配置智能体身份的应用权限。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can provision and manage OAuth 2.0-capable identities for AI agents via Microsoft Graph, including Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities, and configure token exchange.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to set up distinct identities for AI agents, configure OAuth token exchange (e.g., fmi_path, OBO), or handle cross-tenant agent identity flows.

say_en.text: Create an identity blueprint for my new agent.
say_en.note: Claude will call Graph API to create an Agent Identity Blueprint.

say_en.text: Add an agent instance identity to the blueprint.
say_en.note: Claude will create a per-instance Agent Identity.

say_en.text: Configure application permissions for the agent identity.
say_en.note: Claude will grant appRoleAssignments to the specified identity.
